name: ATC_REFERENCE_ENTITIES_
description: Stores detail of all ref entities

columns.name: REF_ENT_ID
columns.description: Unique row id for  reference entity

columns.name: REFERENCE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of the reference object

columns.name: REF_ENT_PUID
columns.description: Indicates identifier of the reference entity

columns.name: REF_ENT_HREF
columns.description: Indicates reference to the reference entity

columns.name: REF_ENT_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of the reference entity

columns.name: REF_ENT_VERSION
columns.description: Indicates version of the entity

columns.name: REF_ENT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of entity

columns.name: REF_ENT_PATH
columns.description: Path represent the hierarchy of the component PO with in the product offering. Where subject entity(offer id along with the associated parents i.e package_Id.bundledPO_Id.atomicOffer_Id),which is used in the runtime system to identify the subject entity that may be used in some other packages.

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the actual class type of an entity

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the base class of a given resource that has been extended

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the entity to which it is associated to

columns.name: AT_REFERRED_TYPE
columns.description: REFERRED ENTITY TYPE

columns.name: VERSION_STATE
columns.description: Used to indicate the current version state of the Entity

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the type of the entity to which it is associated to

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
